players.product: Data-center cooling (Airedale chillers/CRAHs, liquid cooling) — pure-play after PT spin

quarterly_data.signal: Modine's fourth quarter fiscal 2026 release reports sales of its Climate Solutions segment (a mixed segment: the presentation lists Data Centers, HVAC Technologies and Heat Transfer Solutions under it) of $665.9 million for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, compared with $356.3 million one year ago, with segment gross margin of 24.6 percent (510 basis points lower, primarily from planned and temporary costs of the rapid expansion of manufacturing capacity for data center products) and adjusted EBITDA of $124.3 million. The earnings presentation adds that Modine ended the year with a second consecutive quarter of record order intake, that Heat Transfer Solutions revenue grew 19% in Q4 FY26 largely on higher coils sales to data center and heat pump customers, and that its 3-megawatt chiller delivers a 50% increase in cooling capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: Climate Solutions Q4 sales $665.9 million (vs $356.3 million); gross margin 24.6 percent; adjusted EBITDA $124.3 million; Heat Transfer Solutions +19% in Q4 FY26; 3-megawatt chiller 50% increase in cooling capacity

quarterly_data.signal: Modine's fourth quarter fiscal 2026 earnings presentation states the company-wide fiscal 2027 net sales outlook of +20% to +35% as $3.82B to $4.29B (the outlook includes the Performance Technologies business, planned to be spun off, for all of fiscal 2027), estimates fiscal 2027 capital expenditures at approximately $150 to $200 million, and expects fiscal 2027 free cash flow of 4 to 6 percent of net sales. Fiscal 2026 free cash flow was $105.4 million, including $152.8 million in the fourth quarter driven by a data center customer upfront cash payment.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 net sales outlook $3.82B to $4.29B; FY2027 capex approximately $150 to $200 million; FY2027 free cash flow 4 to 6 percent of net sales; FY2026 free cash flow $105.4 million (Q4 $152.8 million)
